'''Ty''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[Dagger Wing]], imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] along with the rest of the squadron after the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ondorru]] tricked them into [[Bombing of Fest|bombing]] civilian targets on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fest/Legends|Fest]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Dagger Wing volunteered to aid the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] prison forces keep order, and Symo, along with [[Lin (Dagger Wing)|Lin]] and [[Symo]], volunteered to help Guard [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Brok (Belsavis)|Brok]] prevent the prisoner [[Gouge]] from escaping one of the labor camps. The group found Gouge, but they were pinned down until [[Havoc Squad]] arrived to evacuate them. After all members of the squadron were accounted for, Guard Captain [[Zess]] arranged for their transit to [[Macula Station]], from where the pilots were able to rejoin the war effort.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ty appears in the Trooper class mission "Overwhelming Force" on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
